method: Strict containment in the occurrence-year January 1 official reference; preserve original codes and unresolved decisions.
limitations: An annual January 1 reference does not establish every later boundary change in that year.
Uncoded source polygons are retained separately and checked for containment; no municipal code is invented.
A boundary mismatch can reflect source coordinates or boundary precision; no nearest-region correction.
This pilot supports nationwide methodology; it does not certify nationwide historical jurisdictions or road assignment.
